etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From Middle English wantyng, wantynge, wantand, equivalent to want +‎ -ing.
senses: present participle and gerund of want

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From Middle English wantyng, wantynge, equivalent to want +‎ -ing.
senses: The state of wanting something; desire.
